from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection: its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title as written")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
